Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the description of daily worship, add Mengzi’s feeling to show why he keeps doing it, for example: “孟子觉得祭拜很好玩。”
2. At the classmates’ teasing, add a short line of speech to make the scene more vivid, for example: “同学们笑着说：‘你怎么每天都在祭拜？’”
3. When his mother notices the influence, add her worried thought, for example: “孟子的妈妈很着急，心想：‘不能让他再这样下去了。’”

ideas.reason: It conflicts with the stated reason that he worships because his mother told him it was important.
The traditional tale has Mengzi copying funeral rituals near a cemetery, not classmates teasing him at school.
It adds a simple, fitting worried reaction that motivates the move.
